$comment: Adjudicated PRE-EXISTING sites for db/gates/check-returned-property-reads.mjs.
THIS FILE IS EMPTY ON PURPOSE, and that is a measurement rather than an
omission. The gate landed on a tree carrying ZERO findings over 608 reads
judged against a resolved producer contract, so every red it reports is NEW
and belongs to the push that produced it. The denominator is the load-bearing
half: the gate fails outright when it judges nothing, because a zero over an
empty analyzable set is the confident zero this repo keeps paying for.
Read this before adding an entry: NOTHING HERE IS AN APPROVED SHAPE. An entry
records a real read of a property its producer never returns -- a value that
is always `undefined`, which an `||` or `??` fallback then absorbs silently.
Entries exist only so a gate cannot go red on standing debt nobody in the
push introduced, since a red master defers every session's push.
Every entry is keyed on a SITE -- (reader, callee, property) -- and NEVER on
the property name alone. A name-keyed entry would suppress that property at
every reader in the tree, which is the same stoplist failure that hid
scoring_format_player_projection_points.total from check-renamed-column-consumers.
The LINE is deliberately not part of the key, so an unrelated edit above a
finding does not stale its entry -- an entry that goes stale on someone
else's edit teaches people to regenerate this file wholesale rather than
read it.
An entry that suppresses nothing is reported as a STALE ADJUDICATION and
fails the gate, so a repaired site forces its entry out rather than leaving a
standing exemption. Removing an entry is the LAST step of a repair, in the
same commit.
verdict = pre-existing-defect   a real absent-key read predating the entry.
The reason must name where the repair is
tracked. There is no other verdict: this gate
reports nothing that is correct by design.
